name: How much do commercial tenant improvements cost per square foot?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost per square foot for commercial tenant improvements in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What is the typical cost per square foot for commercial tenant improvements in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tenant improvement pricing varies mostly by use, finish level, and how much hidden infrastructure must be replaced. Office build-outs are often the lowest among common commercial uses, while retail, medical, and restaurant spaces cost more because they need more mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire, and code-related work. In Los Angeles, older buildings can push costs higher because you may discover seismic, accessibility, or utility upgrades that were not obvious at bid time. A useful budget should separate hard construction costs from soft costs such as design, engineering, permits, testing, and contingency. Owners should also ask whether the quote includes demolition, utility tie-ins, sprinkler changes, and after-hours work, because those items can materially change the final number. The best comparisons are apples-to-apples scopes with the same finish level and same assumption about permit and utility work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial tenant improvements in Los Angeles can range widely by use: office work is often lower, retail is mid-range, medical space is higher, and restaurant construction is usually the most expensive. Cost rises with code upgrades, MEP work, finishes, and permit complexity.
